title: Complete drug-repurposing workflow against a validated target
scientific_question: Can BioNexus produce an auditable, reproducible ranking of repurposing candidates while preserving the evidence chain from target selection through docking, MD, ADMET and publication output?

stages.gate: target rationale is externally cited and provenance-complete
input and prepared structures are immutable and traceable
predeclared redocking criterion is evaluated before screening
stages.preferred_acceptance: symmetry-aware heavy-atom RMSD <= 2.0 angstrom where chemically appropriate

stages.gate: all screened compounds remain in raw output including failures
pose-derived claims reference exact pose and method
trajectory analysis records simulation and analysis parameters
ADMET predictions remain predictions and are not stated as measured pharmacology
unsupported factual or numeric claims are rejected in audited mode
paper narrative is derived from persisted results rather than regenerated from memory

primary_endpoints: reproduction success on an independent environment
statistics: cross-validation where predictive models are evaluated
predeclared significance tests only when their assumptions match the design
minimum_external_validation: at least one reference co-crystal redocking case where available
measured activity/affinity values for ranking comparison
execution on at least two operating environments before a robustness claim
publication_boundary: Completion of this contract can support a reproducibility and interpretability case study. It does not establish drug efficacy, clinical benefit or experimental validation unless those data are independently supplied.
